name: Admin Document PDF Preview
description: Admin previews the generated PDF from the document edit page ('Previsualizar PDF', data-testid doc-preview-pdf) instead of downloading it to find out how it came out. The viewer embeds the very file the download delivers — same endpoint with ?inline=1 — so the portada, subportada and contraportada decided by the export checkboxes are visible before downloading; its header (doc-pdf-preview-pages) names the pages of the SAVED configuration, and previewing with pending changes offers 'Guardar y previsualizar' / 'Previsualizar lo guardado' / 'Seguir editando'.
